messages:
clare (People Ops): Quick update: we've published a new policy and process for background checks + visa sponsorship handling. Two manager actions this round: 1) Hiring managers must complete the 12-min 'Hiring Compliance: Background & Visa Checkpoints' micro-module; 2) Verify onboarding benefits eligibility for visa-sponsored hires in the new "Visa Benefits Prefill" tracker. Deadline for manager confirmations: 2026-11-05. Link to policy + tracker: https://go.redwood/hr/visa-background-2026

ricardo (Hiring Ops): TL;DR: Background checks are now standardized across regions (ID verification + criminal + employment verification where local law allows). Visa sponsorship requests must be routed through Hiring Ops before offer acceptance. We'll flag offers missing sponsorship paperwork.

meera (Legal): Legal note: background check scope varies by country; the doc lists country-specific consent language and the minimum required checks. If your candidate's country disallows a check type, use the local variant and note it in the tracker. For EU hires, ensure GDPR consent copy is stored in the secure HR repo.

yasmin (Benefits): Benefits note: Visa-sponsored hires may be eligible for a different benefits enrollment timeline (extended window) in some countries. We prefilled likely timelines in the tracker. Managers: verify and correct the "benefits_timeline" column if it's wrong. Payroll will follow the corrected timeline.

tom (Eng Manager): Quick Q — do I have to complete the 12-min module even if I never run background checks personally? I'm a hiring manager and sign offers.

clare (People Ops): Yes — any manager who signs offers or confirms new hire onboarding must complete the module. It covers legal consent language, required docs, and escalation steps for discrepant checks. If you've completed an equivalent internal course in the last 6 months, DM me and we'll mark you exempt.

ash (Recruiter): Ops note: we'll add an automated flag to the ATS that shows "sponsorship_required" so hiring managers see it on the candidate card. We also plan to push per-manager CSVs with upcoming hires and their visa status.

ricardo (Hiring Ops): Per-manager CSVs will be dropped into People Ops shared folder by EOD today: `visa_exports/2123456789_manager_csvs.zip`. If you need a contractor-only slice or a filter for offers pending sponsorship, DM me.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-10-20T09:00Z — 2-week autopulse to managers who haven't started module.

meera (Legal): One more legal note: do not ask candidates for any medical or protected-class info as part of checks. Use the consent text exactly as in the policy. If you see a red flag (mismatched employment history, unresolved criminal checks), escalate to legal-hiring@redwood.com and cc Hiring Ops.

yasmin (Benefits): Manager checklist: 1) Complete micro-module by 2026-11-05; 2) Verify the "Visa Benefits Prefill" entries for your new hires; 3) Mark confirmations in the Manager Confirmations column; 4) For any timeline corrections, add a one-line reason in the "benefits_note" column.

tom (Eng Manager): Can you give a short blurb I can paste into my channel? Prefer something concise that points to the module and deadline.

clare (People Ops): Use this: `Heads-up: New background-check & visa-sponsorship policy. Hiring managers: please complete the 12-min compliance module and confirm visa benefits timeline by Nov 5. Tracker + policy: https://go.redwood/hr/visa-background-2026`

ash (Recruiter): Uploaded the per-manager CSVs to the shared folder. File: `visa_exports/2123456789_manager_csvs.zip`. If managers want a live slice from the ATS, ping me and I can grant transient access.

ricardo (Hiring Ops): One ops detail: offers that require sponsorship will be placed on a temporary hold flag in the offer desk until Hiring Ops verifies sponsorship paperwork. This prevents accidental acceptance before Visa Ops is engaged.

clare (People Ops): Action recap: managers = complete the 12-min module and confirm entries in the Visa Benefits Prefill tracker by 2026-11-05; correct any timeline prefill errors or flag exceptions with a short note; Hiring Ops will surface CSVs and hold offers needing sponsorship. People Ops will run a compliance export the week after the deadline and follow up with managers who have >3 outstanding confirmations. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
